name: Rugspull
financialTruth: BNB Smart Chain contract state and matching event history. The Worker and D1 are rebuildable discovery caches and must not be used as financial truth.

events.name: RugCreated
events.use: Discover an Instance and bind creator, stake, Opening end, metadata hash, and disclosure hash to the current Factory.

events.name: Contributed
events.use: Record contribution flow without inferring unique people from wallet count.

events.name: LaunchSucceeded
events.use: Bind Token and RugPool, accepted contribution, opening allocation, initial reserves, and Founder Allocation.

events.name: LaunchFailed
events.use: Mark Failed and expose user-initiated refund eligibility; do not describe refunds as automatic.

events.name: ClaimedOpening
events.use: Record the token claim and excess-contribution refund actually executed by one wallet.

events.name: ClaimedFailedRefund
events.use: Record the Failed contribution refund actually executed by one wallet.

events.name: CreatorStakeWithdrawn
events.use: Record creator stake withdrawal after Failed separately from contributor refunds.

events.name: Swap
events.use: Rebuild side, amounts, protocol fee, post-event reserves, price, and WBNB volume.

events.name: RugPulled
events.use: Record the one full protocol-held Founder Allocation exit and quote received.

endpoints.purpose: Current chain, Factory sources, financial-truth boundary, and upload-protection state.
Factory checkpoints, latest indexed block, stale threshold, and warnings.
Current-Factory discovery cache; limit is bounded to 1–100.
Ordered cached events, capped at 100 rows.
Market points and Rug marker; limit is bounded to 20–500.
Up to 24 Rug addresses and up to 16 recent prices per Rug.
Public immutable metadata or image object when the key passes the public-key policy.

marketReconstruction.price: reserveQuote * 1e18 / reserveToken after each LaunchSucceeded or Swap event
marketReconstruction.reserveCheck: Compare RugPool.getReserves() with actual RugToken and WBNB balances.

instanceDiscovery: Each Rug has separate Instance, Token, and RugPool addresses emitted after creation. Do not infer or pre-register nonexistent addresses, and verify each exact deployment separately.
boundaries: Independent audit is pending; source verification and project-authored tests are not an audit or safety guarantee.
Organized new mainnet activity remains NO-GO until the published activation gates are satisfied.
Publication of this package does not claim wallet, terminal, aggregator, directory, BNB Chain, or other third-party integration, review, partnership, recommendation, or endorsement.
Rugged is a contract lifecycle state, not a generic scam verdict, safety label, refund condition, or proof that related wallets stopped trading.
Third parties can create alternative pools; Rugspull cannot remove MEV, guarantee price quality, identify all related wallets, or prevent total loss.
